mechanism: Berberine inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing nortriptyline plasma concentrations and anticholinergic/cardiac effects; additive CNS depression possible.
action: Monitor for increased nortriptyline toxicity (anticholinergic symptoms, arrhythmias, sedation); consider nortriptyline dose reduction or therapeutic drug monitoring if berberine co-administered.
